name: for_each_loop
prompt: Author a FortiSOAR playbook that builds a static list of three alert payloads in a set_variable step, then runs a for_each loop over the list using create_record on the alerts module. Each iteration uses vars.item to populate fields. Output complete YAML.

ir_assertions.note: loops over a variable (set_variable output lives at vars.<name>; the compiler rewrites vars.steps.<step>.<name> to it, so the resolved IR never holds vars.steps. here)
the list is built before the loop that creates the alerts
